title: NOMOS Freshness Staple
description: A short-lived, detached statement signed by a key's own PARENT — the same key permitted to revoke it (NOMOS-SPEC-007 §5.1) — asserting the child key is not revoked as of a point in time. A presenter attaches staples to a chain presentation so a verifier with no revocation source of its own (§5.5) gets a bounded, disclosed confidence upgrade from 'unchecked' to 'staple', instead of a silent 'unknown'. The root is out of scope: nothing certifies a root, so nothing but the relying party's own decision to un-pin it answers 'is my root still good'.

child_kid.description: The kid this staple vouches for.

parent_kid.description: The signer — MUST be the same parent_kid that actually certified child_kid in some certificate the verifier is walking. A verifier MUST NOT verify a staple against any other key, regardless of what this field claims.

as_of.description: When this staple was signed. Part of the signed payload.

valid_until.description: When this staple stops being usable. Part of the signed payload. RECOMMENDED short — minutes to roughly an hour, not the years-long scale of a certificate's own expires_at. This document does not mandate an exact figure, matching NOMOS-SPEC-006 §6.2's treatment of max_age as advisory rather than fixed.

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over JCS({ child_kid, parent_kid, as_of, valid_until }) — produced with the PARENT's private key, the same key that certified child_kid.
